metadata.note: AUR-from-source end-to-end test for the QEMU harness. Minimal bootable system + one AUR package (aur-downgrade) that dasik builds from source with makepkg inside arch-chroot. Exercises the full AUR pipeline: install base-devel/git, create the _aurbuilder user, git clone from aur.archlinux.org, makepkg -sri, and idempotency (a 2nd apply must NOT rebuild). downgrade is a non-helper package so it takes the makepkg-fallback path (not yay/paru). NOT for real hardware.
